description.en: Connects Bowmark's remote MCP server (api.bowmark.ai/mcp) to DSH. Bowmark exposes typed functions for live websites; the plugin registers its tools and reads the API key from the BOWMARK_API_KEY credential reference.
description.zh: 将 Bowmark 的远程 MCP 服务（api.bowmark.ai/mcp）接入 DSH。Bowmark 为在线网站提供带类型的函数；插件注册其工具，并从 BOWMARK_API_KEY 凭据引用中读取 API 密钥。
